objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: and then, moving first on $M''=M\setminus\{p_j,\ell\}$, guarantees $\operatorname{odd}(M'')$ by induction.
objection.witness: After Liu and Xiang each claim one piece, Liu—not Xiang—moves first on the remainder. Induction therefore gives Xiang the even-indexed, not odd-indexed, guarantee. The lemma is repairable by using that guarantee and checking the resulting inequalities.
